result: At modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, JsonRpcRequest<R> derives Serialize and flattens its request field, while JsonRpcMessage is an untagged enum whose Request variant contains JsonRpcRequest<Req>. Combined with the already-verified Request<M,R> serializer, this means params._meta is part of the serialized ClientJsonRpcMessage request object. In the UnixSocketHttpClient StreamableHttpClient outbound path, post_message_with_max_sse_event_size serializes the ClientJsonRpcMessage directly with serde_json::to_string(&message) and places that exact JSON string into the HTTP request body. No intervening source-level transform in the inspected path strips or rewrites params._meta before the final outbound HTTP body.
